issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers class defines a method named 'appendElement' but the template's Stock class (and the solution) call 'ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray'. This name/signature mismatch will cause compilation errors for students using the provided template and prevents them from using ArrayHelpers as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method name/signature across the template: either rename the method in template ArrayHelpers from 'appendElement' to 'addElementToArray' (matching Stock.java and the solution), or update Stock.addToStockIngredients (and other callers) to use 'appendElement'. Ensure ArrayHelpers contains the expected generic signature used by Stock.

issues.description: The ArrayHelpers method is named appendElement(...) in the template but other code (template Stock.java and the solution) call ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This inconsistent identifier for the same helper function will prevent students from compiling and mapping the helper usage: they will see Stock.addToStockIngredients calling addElementToArray but the provided ArrayHelpers doesn't define it.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across artifacts. Rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (matching Stock.java and the solution), or alternatively update Stock.java to call appendElement(...). Prefer renaming appendElement to addElementToArray to match the solution and other uses.
